card.name: Verb right after sentence-opening To or When
card.fires_on: The verb right after an opening 'To' or 'When' that starts a purpose or condition clause, such as 'To serve', 'To determine', 'To qualify' and 'When administered'. Also fires weakly on the digit 7 in years like 187x.
